# Policy engine reference

Source of truth: `backend/app/domain/policy/`. Every decision cites one of these rule IDs.

Severities: **block** stops the request · **route** adds a human approval step · **flag** is a non-blocking signal · **info** explains an automatic outcome.

## Rules

| ID | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VAL-001` | Request has no value | A request needs at least one line with a positive total. |
| `VAL-002` | Cost centre missing | Every request must be charged to a cost centre. |
| `VAL-003` | Emergency justification insufficient | Emergency purchases bypass line-manager approval, so they require a written justification. |
| `VAL-004` | Currency mismatch | Request currency must match the policy currency (multi-currency approval is future scope). |
| `VEN-001` | Vendor blocked or suspended | Purchases from blocked or suspended vendors are not allowed. |
| `VEN-002` | Vendor not yet approved | Vendors pending onboarding review require procurement review. |
| `VEN-003` | High-risk vendor | High-risk vendors require procurement review. |
| `VEN-004` | No active contract for contract-controlled category | This category must be bought under an active contract; off-contract purchases need procurement review. |
| `VEN-005` | Vendor not registered for category | The vendor is not registered for this spend category. |
| `VEN-006` | Sourcing required | Contract-controlled category with no vendor selected: procurement must source a contracted vendor. |
| `APR-001` | Manager approval | Requests above the auto-approval limit need line-manager approval. |
| `APR-002` | Department head approval | Requests above the manager limit need department-head approval. |
| `APR-003` | Procurement review (value) | High-value requests need procurement review. |
| `APR-004` | Procurement review (category) | This category always needs procurement review. |
| `APR-005` | Emergency approval | Emergency purchases are approved by the department head directly and reviewed retrospectively. |
| `BUD-001` | No budget defined | No budget exists for the cost centre and fiscal year; finance must approve. |
| `BUD-002` | Budget exceeded | The request would exceed the remaining budget; finance must approve. |
| `BUD-003` | Budget nearly exhausted | Budget utilisation after this request is above the warning level. |
| `SPL-001` | Possible split purchase | Recent requests in the same category, combined with this one, cross an approval threshold that each stays under individually. |
| `EMG-001` | Emergency purchase | Flagged for retrospective procurement review. |
| `AUTO-001` | Auto-approved | Low-value request with no risk signals; approved by policy. |

## Default policy configuration (example values, JPY)

Each tenant starts with these values as policy v1 and publishes its own versions.

| Setting | Default |
|---|---|
| `currency` | `"JPY"` |
| `auto_approval_limit` | `"30000"` |
| `manager_approval_limit` | `"500000"` |
| `procurement_review_threshold` | `"1000000"` |
| `procurement_review_categories` | `["software", "professional_services"]` |
| `contract_required_categories` | `["software", "professional_services", "logistics"]` |
| `budget_warning_utilization` | `"0.90"` |
| `split_purchase_window_days` | `14` |
| `emergency_min_justification_chars` | `40` |
| `approval_sla_hours` | `48` |

## Purchase-request state machine

| From | Action | Allowed targets |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | `edit` | `draft` |
| `draft` | `submit` | `approved`, `pending_approval`, `policy_blocked` |
| `draft` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `pending_approval` | `approve_step` | `approved`, `pending_approval` |
| `pending_approval` | `reject` | `rejected` |
| `pending_approval` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `policy_blocked` | `reopen` | `draft` |
| `policy_blocked` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `rejected` | `reopen` | `draft` |
| `rejected` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `approved` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
